description: 1. READ SKILL.md to discover the exact proprietary methodology. 2. PARSE data/raw/gap_reversal_trades_raw.csv, handling messy rows (ERROR values, None, N/A dates, empty shares) → identify ~139 valid trades → classify as 'preferred' confidence tier (100-199 range) per SKILL.md tiers. 3. PARSE data/raw/parameter_sweep_results.csv and apply the EXACT SKILL.md stop-loss multipliers [0.50, 0.75, 1.00, 1.25, 1.50] and profit-target multipliers [0.80, 0.90, 1.00, 1.10, 1.20] — not arbitrary ranges. Detect that stop-loss results form a PLATEAU (all 5 profitable) and profit-target results show a SPIKE (only 1-2 profitable near baseline). 4. PARSE data/processed/walkforward_summary.json and compute OOS/IS ratio (~36%) — flag it as below the 50% threshold specified in SKILL.md as a 'warning sign'. Also note that parameter_reoptimization_needed=True is a SKILL.md red flag. 5. PARSE data/processed/yearly_breakdown.json — identify 4/6 years positive (majority met), but note 2 losing years. 6. DETECT from strategies/gap_reversal/strategy_meta.json that slippage_model='conservative_1x' which violates the SKILL.md requirement of 1.5-2x and flag this. 7. OUTPUT validation_report.json with all sections populated and a final decision of REFINE or ABANDON (NOT DEPLOY) because: OOS < 50% threshold, profit-target is a fragile spike not a plateau, and slippage is under-tested.
